User Story: SESS-01 TERM-17
Expected Behavior: TUI apps (claude/codex) render garbled on peers — no host↔peer grid-size sync
Code Refs: Host PTY+grid sized to the host window (handleResize); peer grids sized to the peer's own window (makePeerTab defaults / handleResize); no frame carries cols/rows (tabOpen is id+title only). TUIs paint with absolute cursor addressing for the host's geometry, so any size difference wraps/interleaves rows on the peer. Reproduced 2026-07-03 live (host 860px vs peer 800px window): host clean, peer banner duplicated+corrupted. Scrolling still works (BUG-35 wheel routing sends SGR to the host's claude). Related: encodeTerminalSnapshot omits modes (DECSET 1049/mouse), so joining mid-TUI also garbles until the app fully repaints
Test Notes: hostGridSize frame (0x24): host broadcasts cols/rows on resize + sends to each joiner before tab snapshots; peer grids pinned via GridModel.remotelySized (view resizing skipped; renderer draws visible intersection with grid-cols stride); join snapshot replays alt-screen + mouse DECSETs; verified live in 2-user session with claude at mismatched window sizes incl. mid-session host resize
